definition_zh: 幼年的；青少年的；幼稚的；（名词）幼体、青少年
definition_en: young and not yet mature; of or for young people; (noun) a young animal or a young person below the legal age of adulthood
core_image: 育幼室的玻璃窗前，一只幼年黑猩猩抓着奶瓶，饲养员在记录板上写下体重
scene: 动物园的育幼室里，饲养员每天给一只幼年黑猩猩称重，记录它第一次自己抓握奶瓶的时刻。Keepers weighed the juvenile chimpanzee every morning during its first year.
sceneCN: 这里用作形容词，指尚未成年的（第 1 个义项：生物学上处于幼年阶段的）；句意为饲养员在这只幼年黑猩猩出生后的第一年里每天为它称重。图中可辨识物件：育幼箱、奶瓶、记录板、玻璃窗。

pos.zh: 形容词：幼年的；未成年的；幼稚的

derivatives.zh: 由形容词加表示「性质」的词尾构成，义为「幼稚；少年状态」
名词复数形式，义为「幼体们；青少年们」
由拉丁词根加表示「开始进入某状态」的词尾构成，义为「幼态延续；保持年轻状态」
由表示「再次」的前缀加拉丁词根构成，义为「使恢复年轻；使复苏」

senses.title: Young and not yet mature
senses.definition: of an organism that has not reached sexual or adult maturity
senses.definitionCN: 指生物尚未达到性成熟或成体阶段的
senses.example: The juvenile birds still followed their mother for food.
senses.exampleCN: 这些幼鸟仍然跟着母亲觅食。
senses.why: The word simply marks the stage before adulthood, so it applies to any species whose young differ from the adult form.
senses.whyCN: 这个词只标记成年之前的那一阶段，因此适用于任何幼体与成体形态不同的物种。

senses.title: A young animal or plant
senses.definition: a noun for an individual in its early stage of life
senses.definitionCN: 作名词，指处于生命早期阶段的个体
senses.example: The reef was crowded with juveniles of three different fish species.
senses.exampleCN: 礁区挤满了三种鱼的幼体。
senses.why: Biologists need a neutral noun for the stage, because words such as baby or chick are tied to particular groups.
senses.whyCN: 生物学家需要一个中性的阶段名词，因为「婴儿」「雏鸟」之类的词都绑定在特定类群上。

senses.title: A young person below legal adulthood
senses.definition: a noun used in law and social policy for a person who is not yet an adult
senses.definitionCN: 法律与社会政策中作名词，指尚未成年的人
senses.example: The programme offers mentoring to juveniles who have left school early.
senses.exampleCN: 该项目为早早辍学的青少年提供辅导。
senses.why: Legal systems need a category between child and adult, and this word supplies the neutral label for that category.
senses.whyCN: 法律体系需要在儿童与成人之间设一档，这个词就提供了这一档的中性标签。

senses.title: Childish or immature in manner
senses.definition: an adjective describing behaviour that seems too young for the person's age
senses.definitionCN: 形容行为与年龄不相称、显得过于孩子气
senses.example: It was a juvenile joke, and nobody laughed.
senses.exampleCN: 那是个幼稚的玩笑，没人笑。
senses.why: The biological sense of not-yet-adult slides easily into a judgement about behaviour that has not matured either.
senses.whyCN: 「尚未成年」这一生物学含义很容易滑向对行为的评判：行为同样没有成熟。

senses.title: The juvenile court system
senses.definition: the branch of law that handles young offenders with different procedures from adult courts
senses.definitionCN: 以不同于成人法庭的程序处理少年违法者的法律分支
senses.example: The juvenile court prioritised schooling over punishment.
senses.exampleCN: 少年法庭把就学安排置于惩罚之上。
senses.why: Because young offenders are still developing, the legal system separates their cases and aims at correction rather than simple penalty.
senses.whyCN: 由于少年违法者仍在发育，法律体系把他们的案件分开处理，目标在矫正而非单纯惩罚。

senses.title: Juvenile delinquency
senses.definition: the fixed term for law-breaking by minors, studied in criminology and social work
senses.definitionCN: 指未成年人违法的固定术语，是犯罪学与社会工作的研究对象
senses.example: The report linked juvenile delinquency to absent after-school care.
senses.exampleCN: 报告把少年犯罪与缺少课后照管联系起来。
senses.why: The phrase names a social problem rather than a legal category, which is why it carries a policy charge the bare adjective lacks.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语命名的是一个社会问题而非法律类别，因此它带有单纯形容词所没有的政策意味。

senses.title: Juvenile literature
senses.definition: the publishing category for books written for children and young teenagers
senses.definitionCN: 面向儿童与少年读者的出版类别
senses.example: The library moved juvenile literature to the ground floor.
senses.exampleCN: 图书馆把少儿读物移到了一层。
senses.why: Publishers needed a shelf label for the reading age, and the word supplied a neutral one.
senses.whyCN: 出版方需要一个按阅读年龄划分的书架标签，这个词提供了中性选项。

senses.title: Juvenile hormone
senses.definition: an insect hormone that keeps the larva in its juvenile form and prevents premature metamorphosis
senses.definitionCN: 昆虫体内维持幼虫形态、阻止过早变态的激素
senses.example: A drop in juvenile hormone triggers the insect to pupate.
senses.exampleCN: 保幼激素水平下降会触发昆虫化蛹。
senses.why: The hormone literally keeps the insect juvenile, so the technical name reuses the everyday adjective in its strict biological sense.
senses.whyCN: 这种激素字面上就是让昆虫保持幼态，因此技术名称沿用了日常形容词的严格生物学含义。

senses.title: Juvenile water in geology
senses.definition: water that has never been part of the atmosphere or surface cycle, released from magma
senses.definitionCN: 从未进入大气或地表循环、由岩浆释放的水
senses.example: Geologists sampled juvenile water from a deep fracture.
senses.exampleCN: 地质学家从一条深断裂中采集了初生水。
senses.why: The geological sense borrows the same image of a substance still in its first, unmodified state.
senses.whyCN: 地质学含义借用了同一个意象：某种物质仍处于最初、未被改造的状态。

intro.en: The word comes from Latin iuvenis, a young person, through the adjective iuvenilis. Its Latin ancestry is clear; only the exact date of its first English use is approximate.
intro.cn: 这个词经拉丁形容词进入英语，源头是表示「年轻人」的拉丁名词。其拉丁渊源清楚，只有进入英语的确切年代为约数。

items.en: Iuvenis meant a young person, and it stood in contrast to senex, an old one.
items.cn: 这个词指年轻人，与表示「老人」的词相对。

items.en: The adjective iuvenilis meant youthful or belonging to youth, and it is the direct source of the English word.
items.cn: 这个形容词表示「年轻的、属于青年的」，是英语词的直接来源。

items.en: Iuventus, youth, and iuvenca, a young cow, come from the same stock, which is also behind the comparative junior.
items.cn: 表示「青年」与「小母牛」的拉丁词出自同一词族，比较级形式的「较年幼的」也来自这里。

items.en: English adopted the adjective in the seventeenth century in the sense of youthful or suitable for young people.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪引入这个形容词，义为「年轻的」或「适合年轻人的」。

items.en: In the nineteenth and twentieth centuries the word specialised in two directions: the legal minor and the young organism.
items.cn: 在十九与二十世纪，这个词朝两个方向专门化：法律上的未成年人，以及生物学上的幼体。

note.en: The first group shares the stem or the fixed compounds; the second group names other ways of being young.
note.cn: 第一组共享词干或固定搭配；第二组是「年轻」的其他说法。

entries.definition: The plural noun for young animals or young people.
entries.definitionCN: 指幼体或青少年的复数名词。

entries.definition: Works produced by an author in childhood or youth.
entries.definitionCN: 作者童年或青年时期的作品。

entries.definition: The court that handles young offenders.
entries.definitionCN: 处理少年违法者的法庭。

entries.definition: The insect hormone maintaining larval form.
entries.definitionCN: 维持幼虫形态的昆虫激素。

entries.definition: The quality of being juvenile.
entries.definitionCN: 幼稚、年幼的状态。

entries.definition: A person in the teenage years; also the adjective for that stage.
entries.definitionCN: 处于青少年时期的人，也可作该阶段的形容词。

entries.definition: Not yet fully developed, used of bodies, behaviour or ideas.
entries.definitionCN: 尚未充分发育的，可用于身体、行为或想法。

entries.definition: The general word for having lived a short time.
entries.definitionCN: 表示「年岁小」的通用词。

entries.definition: Below the legal age for a activity or right.
entries.definitionCN: 未达到某项活动或权利的法定年龄。

entries.definition: Behaving in a way judged too young, usually negatively.
entries.definitionCN: 行为显得过于孩子气，通常带贬义。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations run through the life stage, the legal category and the technical compounds; abstract ones keep the image of something still in its first form.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想串联生命阶段、法律类别与技术搭配；抽象联想保留「仍处最初形态」的意象。

normal.en: Juvenile is the stage before adult, in any species.
normal.cn: 幼年就是任何物种成年之前的那个阶段。

normal.en: As a noun it can be a young animal or a legal minor, depending on the room it is used in.
normal.cn: 作名词时可以是幼兽，也可以是法律上的未成年人，取决于使用场合。

normal.en: Juvenile court and juvenile delinquency belong to the legal family.
normal.cn: 少年法庭与少年犯罪属于法律这一族用法。

normal.en: Juvenile hormone keeps an insect in its larval body on purpose.
normal.cn: 保幼激素有意让昆虫停留在幼虫身体里。

normal.en: The geology sense keeps water in its first, untouched state.
normal.cn: 地质学含义让水保持最初、未被触碰的状态。

abstract.en: Juvenile is a door marked not yet, and every field decides what lies beyond it.
abstract.cn: 「幼年」是一扇写着「尚未」的门，每个领域自行决定门后是什么。

abstract.en: The same word can describe a body, a behaviour and a drop of water, because all three are unfinished.
abstract.cn: 同一个词能形容身体、行为与一滴水，因为三者都尚未完成。

abstract.en: Growing up is mostly a change of label.
abstract.cn: 长大，多半只是标签的更换。

examples.en: The juvenile fish stay in the shallows until they are large enough to migrate.
examples.cn: 幼鱼留在浅水区，直到长到足以迁徙。

examples.en: The juvenile court handles cases involving offenders under eighteen.
examples.cn: 少年法庭处理涉及十八岁以下违法者的案件。

examples.en: Juvenile hormone levels determine when the larva can pupate.
examples.cn: 保幼激素水平决定幼虫何时可以化蛹。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「猪维奈尔」——小猪还没长大，正是「幼年的」：幼年的、青少年

root: 来自拉丁语 iuvenis「年轻人」，经形容词 iuvenilis「年轻的」进入英语，十七世纪起使用。同族还有表示「青年」与「小母牛」的词，以及比较级形式的「较年幼的」。拉丁渊源清楚，英语首见年代为约数。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses spread across three worlds: the biological stage, the legal minor, and the technical compounds that keep the literal sense.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项分布在三个世界：生物学阶段、法律上的未成年人，以及保留字面含义的技术搭配。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a nursery window, a young ape holding its bottle, a keeper writing the weight.
core.cn: 核心意象：育幼室窗前，幼猿抱着奶瓶，饲养员记下体重。

branches.en: THE CORE: the word marks the stage before adulthood.
branches.cn: 核心：这个词标记成年之前的阶段。

branches.en: THE ORGANISM: as a noun it names the young animal or plant itself.
branches.cn: 生物个体：作名词时指幼体本身。

branches.en: THE PERSON AND THE JUDGEMENT: a legal minor, and behaviour that has not matured.
branches.cn: 人与评判：法律上的未成年人，以及尚未成熟的行为。

branches.en: THE LAW: court and delinquency turn the stage into an institution and a social problem.
branches.cn: 法律：法庭与少年犯罪把这一阶段变成制度与社会问题。

branches.en: THE TECHNICAL USES: reading age, insect hormone, and water still in its first state.
branches.cn: 技术用法：阅读年龄、昆虫激素，以及仍处最初状态的水。

intro.en: The word is one Latin adjective with an English noun life; the endings are the only bound parts.
intro.cn: 这个词是一个拉丁形容词加英语名词用法；黏着成分只有词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies iuvenis, a young person, and the adjective ending -ilis; the same stock gives youth, the comparative junior and the revived verb of making young again.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供了「年轻人」与形容词词尾；同一词族还给出「青年」、「较年幼的」以及「使恢复年轻」的动词。

items.example: It stands opposite the Latin word for an old person.
items.exampleCN: 它与拉丁语中表示老人的词相对。

items.example: It is the direct source of the English adjective.
items.exampleCN: 它是英语形容词的直接来源。

items.example: It turns the noun of a person into an adjective of quality.
items.exampleCN: 它把指人的名词变成性质形容词。

items.example: The abstract noun names the whole period.
items.exampleCN: 这个抽象名词指整个时期。

items.example: The comparative survives in English as a rank and a term for a younger person.
items.exampleCN: 这个比较级在英语中保留为职级与「较年幼者」的称呼。

items.meaning: the state of being young or childish
items.example: The suffix -ity turns the adjective into a quality.
items.exampleCN: 表示「性质」的词尾把形容词变成性质名词。

items.meaning: the process of remaining or becoming young
items.example: The suffix marks the beginning of a state.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾标记进入某种状态的开端。

items.example: The prefix means again, and the verb reverses ageing.
items.exampleCN: 前缀意为「再次」，整个动词表示逆转老化。

derivatives.zh: 由形容词加表示「性质」的词尾构成，义为「幼稚；少年状态」
由形容词转作名词，义为「幼体；青少年」
名词复数形式，义为「幼体们；青少年们」

由表示「再次」的前缀加拉丁词根构成，义为「使恢复年轻；使复苏」

definition_zh: 热切的；渴望的；敏锐的；锋利的；激烈的
definition_en: very eager to do something, or sharp in mind, sense, or edge
core_image: 刀口在光下反出一道细白线，一眼看去就让人缩手
scene: 雪后清早，几个人在门口换鞋，谁都想第一个上坡。The children are keen to see the snow before it melts.
sceneCN: 这里 keen 是「热切的、渴望的」（第 1 个义项：非常想做某事），句意为孩子们急着想在雪化前去看雪。画面里的物件：门口、雪、换鞋的人。

pos.zh: 形容词：热切的；渴望的；敏锐的；锋利的；激烈的

derivatives.zh: 由 keen 加 -ly 构成，义为「热切地；敏锐地」
由 keen 加 -ness 构成，义为「热心；锐利」

senses.title: Very eager to do something
senses.definition: very much wanting to do something or to have something happen
senses.definitionCN: 非常想做某事或希望某事发生
senses.example: He was keen to start work that same week.
senses.exampleCN: 他迫切想当周就开始工作。
senses.why: The sharp edge of wanting points forward at the thing not yet had.
senses.whyCN: 渴望那道「锋刃」朝前指着还没到手的那个东西。

senses.title: Sharp in mind or sense
senses.definition: quick to notice, understand, or feel
senses.definitionCN: 注意、理解或感受得很快
senses.example: She has a keen ear for small changes in tone.
senses.exampleCN: 她对语调里的细微变化很敏感。
senses.why: A faculty described as keen is one that cuts into detail.
senses.whyCN: 被称作 keen 的能力，是能切进细节的那种能力。

senses.title: Sharp in edge
senses.definition: having a fine, cutting edge
senses.definitionCN: 指刀刃又细又快
senses.example: The knife is keen enough to cut paper.
senses.exampleCN: 这把刀快得能切纸。
senses.why: This is the literal edge from which all the other senses borrow their sharpness.
senses.whyCN: 这是字面的刃口，其他各义的「锐利」都从这里借来。

senses.title: Intense or strong in feeling
senses.definition: strong and intense, as of competition, interest, or wind
senses.definitionCN: 指竞争、兴趣或风等强烈而凌厉
senses.example: Competition for the place was keen.
senses.exampleCN: 这个名额的竞争很激烈。
senses.why: Intensity is pressure concentrated on a narrow point, like an edge.
senses.whyCN: 强度就是集中在一点上的压力，像一条刃。

senses.title: Bitter and cold, of weather
senses.definition: piercingly cold, as of wind
senses.definitionCN: 指风等冷得刺人
senses.example: A keen wind came off the water.
senses.exampleCN: 水面上吹来一阵刺骨的风。
senses.why: A wind that feels sharp is weather described with the edge image.
senses.whyCN: 感觉锋利的风，是用刃的画面去写天气。

senses.title: A wailing lament for the dead
senses.definition: a loud lament for a dead person, chiefly Irish usage
senses.definitionCN: 主要指爱尔兰习俗中为死者发出的哭号
senses.example: The women raised a keen over the body.
senses.exampleCN: 妇女们为遗体唱起挽歌。
senses.why: This noun is a separate borrowing, though the cry is high and piercing like the adjective.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词是另一次借词，但那种哭声高而尖，与形容词的感觉相通。

intro.en: Keen comes from Old English cene, meaning bold and brave, and only later took on sharpness and eagerness.
intro.cn: keen 来自古英语 cene「勇敢的」，较晚才发展出「锋利、热切」等义。

items.en: cene meant bold, brave, or fierce in battle.
items.cn: cene 意为战斗中勇敢、勇猛。

items.en: Middle English kene widened to sharp, severe, and quick.
items.cn: 中古英语 kene 扩展到尖锐、严厉、敏捷。

items.en: Related Norse forms reinforced the sense of sharpness and edge.
items.cn: 相关的古北欧语形式加强了「锐利」的感觉。

items.en: The eagerness sense settled in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 「热切」义在十九世纪固定下来。

items.en: The noun keen for a lament came from Irish caoineadh.
items.cn: 表示挽歌的名词 keen 来自爱尔兰语 caoineadh。

note.en: The look-alike group holds short words that look like keen; the near-meaning group holds adjectival first cousins.
note.cn: 形近组收外形容易与 keen 混的短词；近义组收几个形容词近亲。

entries.definition: To have or hold something.
entries.definitionCN: 拼写只差一个字母，义为「保持；保留」，来源不同。

entries.definition: A small barrel.
entries.definitionCN: 拼写相近，指小桶。

entries.definition: A small twist or tight bend.
entries.definitionCN: 拼写相近，义为「扭结；小弯」，来源不同。

entries.definition: Wanting something very much.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「渴望的」，与第 1 个义项最近。

entries.definition: Having a fine edge or quick mind.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「锋利的；机敏的」。

entries.definition: Very sharp or very strong.
entries.definitionCN: 较正式，指极为敏锐或强烈。

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from a brave fighter to a knife and then to a keen student.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从勇敢的战士走到刀刃，再走到热心的学生。

normal.en: Old English cene meant brave, not eager.
normal.cn: 古英语 cene 意为勇敢，而不是热切。

normal.en: Keen on is the preposition for interest, as in keen on music.
normal.cn: 表示兴趣用 keen on，如 keen on music。

normal.en: Keen to do takes the infinitive.
normal.cn: keen to do 后接动词不定式。

normal.en: A keen eye is a sharp eye, not an eager one.
normal.cn: a keen eye 指眼力锐利，不是心急。

normal.en: The Irish keen is a wail over the dead.
normal.cn: 爱尔兰语来源的 keen 是为逝者哭号。

abstract.en: Keen is a blade of attention.
abstract.cn: keen 是注意力磨出的刃口。

abstract.en: Sharp edge, sharp mind, sharp wind: one image, three places.
abstract.cn: 刃利、头脑利、风利：一个比喻用在三处。

abstract.en: The eager and the edged share their keenness.
abstract.cn: 渴望与锋锐共用同一份「利」。

examples.en: She is keen on learning another language.
examples.cn: 她很热衷于学另一门语言。

examples.en: The blade was still keen after years of use.
examples.cn: 这把刀用了多年依然锋利。

examples.en: They have a keen sense of what is fair.
examples.cn: 他们对什么算公平有很敏锐的直觉。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「肯」—— 肯去做的人，才是热切的

root: 古英语 cene「勇敢的、勇猛的」→ 中古英语 kene「尖锐的、敏捷的」→ 现代英语 keen「锋利；敏锐；热切」；挽歌义另来自爱尔兰语 caoineadh。

sensesIntro.en: Six senses: eager, sharp-minded, sharp-edged, intense, bitingly cold, and the Irish lament.
sensesIntro.cn: 六个义项：热切、敏锐、锋利、强烈、刺骨的冷，以及爱尔兰的挽歌。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fine bright edge that makes you draw your hand back.
core.cn: 核心意象：一道细亮的刃口，让人本能地缩手。

branches.en: THE STAIRS: children pushing to be first up.
branches.cn: 楼梯这条线：孩子们抢着先上去。

branches.en: THE EAR: catching a change no one else noticed.
branches.cn: 耳朵这条线：听出别人漏掉的细微变化。

branches.en: THE EDGE AND THE WIND: both cut a little.
branches.cn: 刀刃与风这条线：两者都能割一下。

branches.en: THE MARKET: competition that presses hard.
branches.cn: 市场这条线：紧逼的竞争。

branches.en: THE WAKE: a cry that rises over a body.
branches.cn: 守灵这条线：在遗体上响起的哭声。

intro.en: Keen is a native English adjective and takes only English endings.
intro.cn: keen 是英语本族形容词，只加英语词尾。

latinIntro.en: Keen has no Latin root, so the list below stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: keen 没有拉丁词根，因此下面留空。

definition_zh: 钥匙；关键；答案；键；（音乐）调
definition_en: a shaped piece of metal that opens a lock, or the most important part of something
core_image: 一片齿形金属插进锁孔，转半圈，锁舌应声收回
scene: 房东把一串叮当响的东西交给他，说楼下信箱也要用同一片。He turned the key twice and the door opened.
sceneCN: 这里 key 是「钥匙」（第 1 个义项：开锁的金属片），句意为他拧了两下钥匙，门开了。画面里的物件：门锁、钥匙串、门口。

pos.zh: 名词：钥匙；关键；答案；键；调
动词：键入；使适应（key in / key to）

derivatives.zh: 复合词，指键盘
复合词，指锁孔
复合词，指关键词
加 -less 构成，义为「无钥匙的」
加 -ed 构成，义为「（情绪上）紧张的；已键入的」

senses.title: A shaped metal piece for a lock
senses.definition: a small metal object cut to fit a lock and work its bolt
senses.definitionCN: 按锁孔形状切制、用来开锁的小金属件
senses.example: She keeps a spare key under the mat.
senses.exampleCN: 她在门口的垫子下面留了一把备用钥匙。
senses.why: The core object is shaped to one lock and has no other use.
senses.whyCN: 核心物件只为一把锁成形，别无他用。

senses.title: The most important element
senses.definition: the thing that makes success possible or explains a problem
senses.definitionCN: 使成功成为可能或能解释问题的那个要素
senses.example: Patience is the key to learning a language.
senses.exampleCN: 耐心是学语言的关键。
senses.why: Access turns into explanation: the key opens a problem, not just a door.
senses.whyCN: 「开启」变成「解释」：钥匙打开的不只是门，还有问题。

senses.title: A set of answers or symbols
senses.definition: a list explaining the answers to exercises or the symbols on a map
senses.definitionCN: 解释习题答案或地图符号的说明表
senses.example: Check your answers against the key.
senses.exampleCN: 对照答案核对你的结果。
senses.why: The list that unlocks the exercises borrows the same image of opening.
senses.whyCN: 打开习题的那张表，借用了同一个「开启」的画面。

senses.title: A button pressed with a finger
senses.definition: one of the parts of a keyboard, piano, or similar instrument
senses.definitionCN: 键盘、钢琴等上面按下的部件
senses.example: The letter key is worn away.
senses.exampleCN: 那个字母键已经磨平了。
senses.why: A pressed button works like a small lock that opens a letter.
senses.whyCN: 按下的键就像一把打开字母的小锁。

senses.title: The tonal centre of a piece
senses.definition: the scale in which a piece of music is written
senses.definitionCN: 一首乐曲所依据的调式
senses.example: The song moves into a brighter key.
senses.exampleCN: 这首歌转进了一个明快的调。
senses.why: One note governs where the melody can go, as a key governs a door.
senses.whyCN: 一个音决定旋律能往哪走，正如钥匙决定门。

senses.title: To type in data
senses.definition: to enter information by pressing keys
senses.definitionCN: 通过按键录入信息
senses.example: Key in your name and press enter.
senses.exampleCN: 输入姓名后按回车。
senses.why: Typing is pressing keys in order, one opening after another.
senses.whyCN: 打字就是按顺序按键，一次次开启。

senses.title: Crucially important
senses.definition: most important for a result or explanation
senses.definitionCN: 对结果或解释最为重要
senses.example: Timing was a key factor in the win.
senses.exampleCN: 时机是这次获胜的关键因素。
senses.why: The adjective keeps the idea of the single decisive part.
senses.whyCN: 形容词保留了「唯一决定性部分」这个想法。

intro.en: Key comes from Old English cǣg, a key, a native Germanic word with no known deeper origin.
intro.cn: key 来自古英语 cǣg「钥匙」，是本族日耳曼词，更早的源头已不可考。

items.en: cǣg meant a key for a lock and had no similar Latin source.
items.cn: cǣg 意为开锁的钥匙，并无对应的拉丁来源。

items.en: Middle English keye spread the sense to a means of explanation.
items.cn: 中古英语 keye 把词义扩展到「解释的途径」。

items.en: The musical key sense grew from the idea of a controlling scale.
items.cn: 音乐上的「调」义从「决定全曲的音阶」发展而来。

items.en: The keyboard gave the button sense in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 十九世纪的键盘带来了「键」这一义。

items.en: The adjective and verb key, as in key in, are modern extensions.
items.cn: 形容词 key 与动词 key in 都是近现代扩展。

note.en: The look-alike group holds short forms of the key family and its look-alikes; the near-meaning group holds words for importance.
note.cn: 形近组收 key 词族及其外形相近的词；近义组收表示重要性的词。

entries.definition: The panel of keys on a piano or computer.
entries.definitionCN: 复合词，指钢琴或电脑的键盘。

entries.definition: The opening for a key in a lock.
entries.definitionCN: 复合词，指锁孔。

entries.definition: A platform where ships load.
entries.definitionCN: 发音相同而拼写不同，指码头。

entries.definition: Decisive for an outcome.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「决定性的」。

entries.definition: Needed in order to exist or work.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「必不可少的」。

entries.definition: A piece of evidence that helps solve something.
entries.definitionCN: 指帮助解谜的线索，与「钥匙」比喻相近。

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from a cut piece of metal to a key on a keyboard.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一片切好的金属走到键盘上的一个键。

normal.en: The key to something uses to, not of.
normal.cn: key to something 用 to，不用 of。

normal.en: Under lock and key means safely shut away.
normal.cn: under lock and key 指锁得好好的。

normal.en: A key answers a puzzle, a lock, or an exam paper.
normal.cn: key 既能解谜、开锁，也能对答案。

normal.en: Key in is the verb for typing numbers.
normal.cn: key in 是键入数字的动词用法。

normal.en: Music keys and keyboard keys both come from the same controlling idea.
normal.cn: 音乐上的调与键盘上的键都来自「决定、支配」这一想法。

abstract.en: A key is a small piece of metal shaped to one lock only.
abstract.cn: 钥匙是只为一把锁塑形的一小片金属。

abstract.en: The same word can be an object, a place, and a reason.
abstract.cn: 同一个词既可以是物件、是位置，也可以是理由。

abstract.en: Every problem has a lock somewhere, and often a key too.
abstract.cn: 每个问题都有一把锁，通常也有一把钥匙。

examples.en: I left my keys inside the car.
examples.cn: 我把钥匙落在车里了。

examples.en: Communication is the key to good teamwork.
examples.cn: 沟通是好团队合作的关键。

examples.en: Key in the code and the door opens.
examples.cn: 输入密码，门就开了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ki 钥匙」—— 一插进去，锁就开了

root: 古英语 cǣg「钥匙」，本族日耳曼词，更深来源不明；后引申出「关键、调、键」等义。

sensesIntro.en: Seven senses: the metal key, the crucial element, an answer list, a button, a musical key, typing data, and the adjective for importance.
sensesIntro.cn: 七个义项：金属钥匙、关键、答案表、键、乐调、输入数据，以及表示重要的形容词义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cut piece of metal shaped to fit exactly one lock.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片按一把锁精确切好的金属。

branches.en: THE DOOR: the bolt slides back with one turn.
branches.cn: 门这条线：一拧，锁舌就缩回去。

branches.en: THE ANSWER: the one element that makes it work.
branches.cn: 答案这条线：让一切成立的那一个要素。

branches.en: THE TEXTBOOK: a list of answers at the back.
branches.cn: 教辅这条线：书后的答案表。

branches.en: THE DESK: fingers on a keyboard, data going in.
branches.cn: 桌面这条线：手指在键盘上录入数据。

branches.en: THE SCALE: a home note the melody returns to.
branches.cn: 音阶这条线：旋律总要回到的主音。

intro.en: Key is a native word; compounds and English endings do the whole job.
intro.cn: key 是本族词，复合与英语词尾包办全部构词。

latinIntro.en: Key has no Latin root, so the list below stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: key 没有拉丁词根，因此下面留空。

definition_zh: 键盘；（乐器的）键盘；用键盘输入
definition_en: the set of keys on a computer, typewriter, or musical instrument, or to enter data using such keys
core_image: 一整片排列整齐的方键，中间那行有一条微微磨亮的横道
scene: 深夜书桌前，屏幕的光照着摊开的双手，指尖在方格里起落。He wiped crumbs off the keyboard before starting work.
sceneCN: 这里 keyboard 是「键盘」（第 1 个义项：电脑或打字机上的一整排按键），句意为他开始工作前把键盘上的碎屑擦掉。画面里的物件：书桌、屏幕光、双手。

derivatives.zh: 由 keyboard 加 -ist 构成，指键盘手
由 keyboard 加 -ing 构成，指键盘录入技能
构成词根，指单个按键或钥匙

senses.title: The keys of a computer
senses.definition: the set of letter, number, and function keys used to enter data
senses.definitionCN: 用来输入数据的字母、数字和功能键的总和
senses.example: The laptop keyboard is smaller than a desk one.
senses.exampleCN: 笔记本键盘比台式机的要小。
senses.why: The panel sense is the base layer: keys set into one board.
senses.whyCN: 面板义是基础层：按键装在同一块板上。

senses.title: The keys of a musical instrument
senses.definition: the row of black and white keys on a piano, organ, or synthesizer
senses.definitionCN: 钢琴、风琴或电子琴上的黑白琴键
senses.example: She learned the piano before she touched a keyboard.
senses.exampleCN: 她在弹电子琴之前先学了钢琴。
senses.why: Organs and pianos put the same board of keys under the hands.
senses.whyCN: 风琴和钢琴把同样的一块键板放在手下。

senses.title: An electronic instrument
senses.definition: an electronic instrument played with keys, especially in a band
senses.definitionCN: 用键盘演奏的电子乐器，尤指乐队里的那种
senses.example: The band has drums, bass, and keyboard.
senses.exampleCN: 乐队有鼓、贝斯和键盘。
senses.why: An instrument named after its panel is a short step from the panel itself.
senses.whyCN: 以面板命名的乐器，离面板本身只有一步。

senses.title: The typing skill
senses.definition: the skill or activity of typing on a keyboard
senses.definitionCN: 在键盘上打字的技能或活动
senses.example: Keyboarding is taught in the first year.
senses.exampleCN: 第一年就教键盘录入。
senses.why: A skill named after the tool shows how central the keyboard became.
senses.whyCN: 以工具命名一项技能，说明键盘有多核心。

senses.title: To enter data by keys
senses.definition: to input text or numbers using a keyboard
senses.definitionCN: 使用键盘输入文字或数字
senses.example: The forms were keyboarded overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 这些表格是一夜之间录进去的。
senses.why: The verb simply turns the noun into the action of using it.
senses.whyCN: 动词只是把名词变成使用它的动作。

intro.en: Keyboard is an English compound of key and board, built when keys were set into one panel.
intro.cn: keyboard 是 key 与 board 的英语复合词，在按键被装进同一块面板时才造出来。

items.en: cǣg, key, was the native word for a lock opener.
items.cn: cǣg 是本族词，指开锁的钥匙。

items.en: bord meant a plank, table, or flat surface.
items.cn: bord 意为木板、桌面或平面。

items.en: The compound named the row of keys on an organ in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 十七世纪时这个复合词指风琴上的琴键排。

items.en: Typewriters carried the word to machines for writing in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 十九世纪打字机把词义带到书写机器上。

items.en: Computers fixed the modern sense of the panel in front of the screen.
items.cn: 计算机固定了屏幕前那块面板的现代义。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the key family; the near-meaning group holds other input and musical terms.
note.cn: 形近组收 key 词族；近义组收其他输入与乐器术语。

entries.definition: One button, or a lock opener.
entries.definitionCN: 构成词根，指单个按键或钥匙。

entries.definition: A small set of keys, as on a phone.
entries.definitionCN: 相似复合词，指电话等的小键盘。

entries.definition: The opening for a key.
entries.definitionCN: 相似复合词，指锁孔。

entries.definition: A machine with keys that prints letters.
entries.definitionCN: 指带键盘的打字机。

entries.definition: A large keyboard instrument with strings.
entries.definitionCN: 指钢琴，键盘乐器的代表。

entries.definition: The display surface next to a keyboard.
entries.definitionCN: 指屏幕，与键盘相邻。

normalIntro.en: These hooks run from a plank with keys to the worn shine on the middle row.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从装着按键的木板走到中间那行磨亮的痕迹。

normal.en: Keyboard is simply key plus board, a board of keys.
normal.cn: keyboard 就是 key 加 board，一块放键的板。

normal.en: Board was the old word for a plank or table.
normal.cn: board 原指木板或桌子。

normal.en: A keyboardist plays the keyboard in a band.
normal.cn: keyboardist 是在乐队里弹键盘的人。

normal.en: Keyboard shortcuts save the fingers a trip to the mouse.
normal.cn: 键盘快捷键让手不必去碰鼠标。

normal.en: The organ had a keyboard before the typewriter did.
normal.cn: 风琴上的键盘比打字机上出现得更早。

abstract.en: A keyboard is a field of small squares you touch in order.
abstract.cn: 键盘是一片要按顺序触碰的小方格。

abstract.en: Every key is a word waiting to be chosen.
abstract.cn: 每个键都是一个等着被选中的字。

abstract.en: The worn middle row shows where thoughts pass most.
abstract.cn: 磨亮的中间一行说明思绪最爱从这里过。

examples.en: She spilled tea on the keyboard again.
examples.cn: 她又把茶洒在键盘上了。

examples.en: The keyboard on this laptop is very quiet.
examples.cn: 这台笔记本的键盘很安静。

examples.en: He keyboarded the whole list in one evening.
examples.cn: 他一晚上把整份清单录了进去。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ki 板」—— 一块放满了键的板，就是键盘

root: 古英语 cǣg「钥匙」+ bord「木板、桌面」→ 英语复合词 keyboard，十七世纪指风琴键盘，后指打字机与电脑键盘。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses: computer keys, instrument keys, the electronic instrument, the typing skill, and the verb for keying data.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项：电脑键盘、乐器键盘、电子键盘乐器、键盘录入技能，以及键入数据的动词义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one panel holding a hundred small keys in rows.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块面板上成排装着一百来个小键。

branches.en: THE DESK: letters going in and words coming out.
branches.cn: 书桌这条线：字母进去，词出来。

branches.en: THE PIANO: black and white keys in order.
branches.cn: 钢琴这条线：黑白琴键排成行。

branches.en: THE BAND: a player behind two rows of keys.
branches.cn: 乐队这条线：两排键后面的乐手。

branches.en: THE LAPTOP: a small panel folded on a hinge.
branches.cn: 笔记本这条线：折在铰链上的小面板。

branches.en: THE CLASSROOM: fingers drilled into speed.
branches.cn: 教室这条线：练到熟练的手指。

intro.en: Keyboard is a two-part English compound; the family grows with English endings.
intro.cn: keyboard 是两部分组成的英语复合词，词族靠英语词尾扩展。

latinIntro.en: No Latin root is involved here, so the list below stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词根，因此下面留空。

definition_zh: 肾；肾脏；（供食用的）动物腰子
definition_en: one of the two organs in the lower back that filter waste from the blood and make urine
core_image: 后腰内侧一对蚕豆形的滤器，血液从中流过，废物被滤下、变成尿
scene: 查房时，医生在病历上圈出腰部的位置，告诉家属检查结果不太乐观。One of his kidneys had stopped filtering waste properly.
sceneCN: 这里 kidney 是「肾脏」（第 1 个义项：过滤血液、生成尿液的器官）；句意为他的一个肾脏已经不能正常过滤废物了。

derivatives.zh: 由 kidney 与 bean 复合而成，因豆子形状像肾，义为「芸豆；腰豆」
由 kidney 与 stone 复合而成，义为「肾结石」
由 kidney 加 -shaped 构成，义为「肾形的；豆形的」

senses.title: The organ that filters the blood
senses.definition: one of the two bean-shaped organs in the lower back that remove waste from the blood and produce urine
senses.definitionCN: 位于后腰、呈蚕豆形的一对器官，负责清除血液中的废物并生成尿液
senses.example: Each kidney contains about a million tiny filters called nephrons.
senses.exampleCN: 每个肾脏约含一百万个叫做肾单位的微小滤器。
senses.why: The word names the organ itself, the physical filter that the other senses describe or borrow from.
senses.whyCN: 这个词首先指器官本身，也就是其余义项所描述或借用的那个实体滤器。

senses.title: Renal function shown by tests
senses.definition: the working capacity of the kidneys, as shown by blood and urine tests or by the amount of urine produced
senses.definitionCN: 肾脏的工作能力，由血液与尿液检查或尿量反映出来
senses.example: Her kidneys are still strong enough to clear the contrast dye.
senses.exampleCN: 她的肾功能仍然足以排出造影剂。
senses.why: Because the organ is judged by what it does, doctors say the kidneys are failing, naming the function by the organ.
senses.whyCN: 正因为器官是按其功能来评判的，医生会说肾在衰竭，用器官名代替了功能。

senses.title: An animal kidney eaten as food
senses.definition: the kidney of cattle, sheep, or pigs, cooked and eaten as meat or used in pies and stews
senses.definitionCN: 牛、羊或猪的肾脏，煮熟后作为肉类食用，或用于馅饼与炖菜
senses.example: The butcher trimmed the lamb kidneys and put them beside the chops.
senses.exampleCN: 肉贩修整好羊腰子，放在羊排旁边。
senses.why: The organ keeps its shape and name on the plate: what filtered blood in the animal is sold as offal in the shop.
senses.whyCN: 器官上了餐桌仍保留原来的形状与名称：在动物体内过滤血液的东西，在店里作为内脏出售。

senses.title: The same kind or temperament
senses.definition: in the phrase of the same kidney, of the same kind, type, or temperament, often used of people
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语「of the same kidney」，指同一种类、类型或气质，多用来形容人
senses.example: The two surgeons were of the same kidney: blunt, tireless, and impatient with ceremony.
senses.exampleCN: 这两位外科医生是同一类人：直率、不知疲倦，也讨厌繁文缛节。
senses.why: Old medicine held that organs shaped temperament, so kidney came to mean the kind of person one is; the phrase survives as a formal idiom.
senses.whyCN: 旧时的医学认为器官决定性情，于是 kidney 引申为人的类型；这个短语作为正式习语保留了下来。

senses.title: A bean-like outline
senses.definition: a curved bean-like outline, as in kidney bean or a kidney-shaped table, named after the organ
senses.definitionCN: 像蚕豆一样的弧形轮廓，如 kidney bean 或肾形桌，都因形似肾脏而得名
senses.example: The pool has a kidney shape, with two rounded lobes and a narrow waist.
senses.exampleCN: 这个泳池呈肾形，有两个圆润的叶和一个窄腰。
senses.why: Because the organ has a distinctive curved outline, its name became a shape word for beans, pools, and tables.
senses.whyCN: 因为器官有独特的弧形轮廓，它的名字就成了豆子、泳池和桌子的形状词。

intro.en: Kidney is a Middle English word of uncertain origin, first recorded as kidnere, and the earliest parts are still debated.
intro.cn: kidney 是一个来源不确定的中古英语词，最早记作 kidnere，其构成成分至今仍有争议。

items.en: The second element is generally connected with Old Norse nyra, kidney, which also gives German Niere and Dutch nier.
items.cn: 一般认为后半部分与古诺尔斯语 nyra「肾」有关，这个词还给出德语 Niere 与荷兰语 nier。

items.en: The word first appears in Middle English as kidnere, with the second element already in place and the first unclear.
items.cn: 这个词最早以中古英语 kidnere 出现，后半部分已经成形，前半部分仍不清楚。

items.en: Spelling variants such as kideney and kidney compete, and the modern spelling is fixed only later.
items.cn: kideney、kidney 等拼写变体并存，现代拼写是后来才固定下来的。

items.en: The old belief that the organ governed temperament produces the phrase of the same kidney.
items.cn: 旧时认为肾脏决定性情的看法，产生了「of the same kidney」这一短语。

items.en: Modern English adds the food sense and a large family of compounds such as kidney bean and kidney stone.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了食用义，以及 kidney bean、kidney stone 等一大批复合词。

note.en: The look-alike group holds compounds built on kidney; the near-meaning group holds the medical words for the same organ and its diseases, which come from other roots.
note.cn: 形近组收由 kidney 构成的复合词；近义组收指同一器官及其疾病的医学词，它们来自别的词根。

entries.definition: A bean with a curved shape like a kidney, cooked and eaten as a vegetable.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「芸豆、腰豆」，因豆子形似肾脏而得名，常作蔬菜食用。

entries.definition: An adjective for an object with the curved outline of a kidney.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「肾形的、豆形的」，指物体具有肾脏那样的弧形轮廓。

entries.definition: A hard mass of salts that forms inside a kidney and can block the flow of urine.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「肾结石」，是肾脏内形成的坚硬盐类团块，可阻塞尿液流通。

entries.definition: The medical adjective meaning relating to the kidneys; it comes from Latin ren, a different root from kidney.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「肾的」，是医学专用说法；它来自拉丁语 ren，与 kidney 的词根不同，只是同指一个器官。

entries.definition: The tiny filtering unit inside a kidney, named from the Greek word for kidney.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「肾单位」，是肾脏内部微小的过滤单元，名称来自希腊语的「肾」。

entries.definition: Inflammation of the kidney, a clinical condition rather than the organ itself.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「肾炎」，指肾脏的炎症，是临床病症而不是器官本身。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Middle English form, the common compounds, and the medical words that surround kidney.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的中古英语形式、常见复合词，以及围绕 kidney 的医学词。

normal.en: The Middle English form is kidnere, and the modern word has shortened and respelled it.
normal.cn: 中古英语形式是 kidnere，现代词只是把它缩短并改写了拼写。

normal.en: Kidney bean, kidney stone and kidney-shaped all keep the organ image in front of the noun.
normal.cn: kidney bean、kidney stone 与 kidney-shaped 都把器官的形象放在词的前面。

normal.en: German Niere and Dutch nier are cousins of the second half of kidney.
normal.cn: 德语 Niere 与荷兰语 nier 是 kidney 后半部分的同族词。

normal.en: Of the same kidney means of the same kind, an idiom older than modern medicine.
normal.cn: 「of the same kidney」意为同一类，这个习语比现代医学更古老。

normal.en: Renal is the medical adjective, but it comes from Latin ren, not from kidney.
normal.cn: renal 是医学形容词，但它来自拉丁语 ren，而不是来自 kidney。

abstract.en: See two bean-shaped filters against the back wall, blood flowing in and clean urine flowing out.
abstract.cn: 想象后腰内侧两枚蚕豆形的滤器，血液流进去，清亮的尿液流出来。

abstract.en: See a gauge on the clinic wall drop as the filters slow down, and the nurse writes the number on a chart.
abstract.cn: 想象诊室墙上的仪表随着滤器变慢而下降，护士把数字记在表格上。

abstract.en: See the same bean shape on a butcher block, trimmed and ready for the pan.
abstract.cn: 再想象同样的豆形出现在砧板上，修整干净，等着下锅。

examples.en: The scan showed a small stone lodged in his left kidney.
examples.cn: 扫描显示他左肾里卡着一颗小结石。

examples.en: Doctors watched her kidney function drop after the infection.
examples.cn: 感染之后，医生持续观察她的肾功能下降。

examples.en: She soaked the kidney beans overnight before cooking them.
examples.cn: 她把芸豆泡了一夜才下锅。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奇的你」——小孩（kid）指着自己的腰侧说，这里藏着两颗豆子形的滤器；只是谐音联想，与中古英语 kidnere 无关。

root: 中古英语 kidnere（来源不确定，一般认为后半与古诺尔斯语 nyra「肾」有关）→ kidney；核心义是「后腰内侧那对蚕豆形的滤器」。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses start from the organ: its filtering work, its meat, its use in an old idiom about temperament, and its bean-like shape.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项都从器官出发：它的过滤功能、可食用的腰子、旧习语中代表性情的用法，以及蚕豆般的外形。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two bean-shaped filters against the back wall, taking waste out of the blood.
core.cn: 核心意象：后腰内侧一对蚕豆形滤器，把废物从血液里取出来。

branches.en: THE ORGAN: the bean-shaped body that does the filtering.
branches.cn: 器官线：那颗蚕豆形、真正执行过滤的实体。

branches.en: THE TEST: what the organ does is measured and reported as kidney function.
branches.cn: 检查线：器官所做的事被测量并报告为肾功能。

branches.en: THE PLATE: the same organ appears as food under the same name.
branches.cn: 餐桌线：同一个器官以同样的名字出现在食物里。

branches.en: THE TEMPER: an old belief about organs and character leaves one formal idiom.
branches.cn: 性情线：旧时关于器官与性格的看法留下了一个正式习语。

branches.en: THE OUTLINE: the curved silhouette becomes a shape word for beans and pools.
branches.cn: 轮廓线：那道弧形轮廓成了豆子和泳池的形状词。

intro.en: Kidney is a Middle English word rather than a Latin one; English built its compounds and kept a separate Latin-rooted medical adjective, renal.
intro.cn: kidney 是中古英语词，并非拉丁语词；英语为它造了复合词，医学上另用拉丁词根的形容词 renal。

latinIntro.en: No Latin word shares the root of kidney; Latin names the organ with ren, which gives the medical adjective renal, so no Latin cognate is listed here.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁词与 kidney 同根；拉丁语用 ren 称呼这个器官，并由此产生医学形容词 renal，因此这里不列拉丁同源词。

items.example: The second element is generally traced to this word.
items.exampleCN: 后半部分一般认为可以追溯到这个词。

items.example: Kidnere is the form that opens the English record.
items.exampleCN: kidnere 是英语记录中最早的形式。

items.example: Kideney appears beside kidney in Middle English texts.
items.exampleCN: 在中古英语文本里，kideney 与 kidney 并见。

items.example: Kidney is the settled modern spelling.
items.exampleCN: kidney 是固定下来的现代拼写。

items.example: The plural is used when both organs are meant.

items.meaning: a bean shaped like a kidney
items.example: The compound names the bean by its shape.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词按形状给豆子命名。

items.meaning: a hard mass formed in the kidney
items.example: The compound names a common kidney disorder.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词命名一种常见的肾脏疾病。

items.meaning: having the curved outline of a kidney
items.example: The compound describes an outline, not an organ.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词描述轮廓，而不是器官。

items.example: Renal supplies the clinical adjective that kidney lacks.
items.exampleCN: renal 提供了 kidney 所缺的临床形容词。

definition_zh: 幼儿园
definition_en: a school or class for young children below the age of primary school, where they learn through play
core_image: 一群小孩在挂满纸剪花朵的院子里围坐听老师讲故事
scene: 早晨的巷口，家长牵着孩子走进一道矮栅栏门。Every morning she walks her son to the kindergarten and waves at the gate.
sceneCN: 这里 kindergarten 是「幼儿园」（第 1 个义项：学龄前儿童的游戏式学校），句意是她每天早上送儿子去幼儿园并在门口挥手。画面里有巷口、家长、矮栅栏门和挥手。

derivatives.zh: 加 -er 构成，指幼儿园的孩子或幼教老师，多见于美式口语
是这个词的后半，指花园；原义强调「儿童的花园」
同类机构，指托儿所，英国多用，年龄更小
同类机构，指学前班，兼指学龄前的

senses.title: A school for children before primary school
senses.definition: an institution where children too young for school learn through play
senses.definitionCN: 供未到上学年龄的儿童以游戏方式学习的机构
senses.example: The kindergarten takes children from three years old.
senses.exampleCN: 这所幼儿园招收满三岁的孩子。
senses.why: The name literally means a garden for children, and the garden idea has stayed with the institution.
senses.whyCN: 名字字面就是「儿童的花园」，而花园这个意象一直留在这类机构身上。

senses.title: The year before primary school
senses.definition: the final pre-school year, treated as a stage rather than a place
senses.definitionCN: 上学前的最后一年，被当成一个阶段而非一处场所
senses.example: She learned to write her name in kindergarten.
senses.exampleCN: 她在学前那一年学会了写自己的名字。
senses.why: A place word easily becomes a time word, because the year and the room are experienced together.
senses.whyCN: 地点词很容易变成时间词，因为那一年和那间屋子是一起经历的。

senses.title: A play-based first school
senses.definition: the style of early teaching in which play rather than lessons comes first
senses.definitionCN: 以游戏为主、而不是以课程为先的早期教学方式
senses.example: This kindergarten builds its whole day around play.
senses.exampleCN: 这家幼儿园整天的安排都围绕游戏。
senses.why: The founding idea of such schools was to let children grow like plants, so the word also names a method.
senses.whyCN: 这类学校的创立理念是让孩子像植物一样生长，所以这个词也指一种方法。

intro.en: Kindergarten is a German coinage that English borrowed whole, a rare case of an everyday English word invented by a nineteenth-century educator.
intro.cn: kindergarten 是德语新造词，被英语整体借入，是罕见的由十九世纪教育家发明、如今天天使用的英语词。

items.en: The two parts are German Kinder, children, and Garten, garden.
items.cn: 两个部分是德语 Kinder（儿童）与 Garten（花园）。

items.en: The German educator Friedrich Froebel coined the word for his play-centred schools for small children.
items.cn: 德国教育家福禄贝尔为他那些以游戏为中心的幼儿学校造出这个词。

items.en: The word travelled with the movement to Britain and the United States in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 这个词随着这场教育运动在十九世纪传到英国和美国。

items.en: English kept the German spelling, though the plural follows English rules.
items.cn: 英语保留了德语拼写，但复数按英语规则加 -s。

items.en: In American use the word came to mean the first year of formal school rather than a separate garden-like institution.
items.cn: 在美式用法里，这个词指正式上学的第一年，而不完全是独立的「花园式」机构。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words sharing the garden part or the child part; the near-meaning group holds other kinds of early-childhood care.
note.cn: 形近组收共享「花园」或「儿童」部分的词；近义组收其他形式的幼儿照护机构。

entries.definition: The second half of the word, a plot of ground for plants.
entries.definitionCN: 这个词的后半，指种花木的园地。

entries.definition: A class of things, spelled like the opening of this word but with no family link.
entries.definitionCN: 指类别，开头字母与本词相同，只是拼写巧合。

entries.definition: The English sense of the German first half.
entries.definitionCN: 对应德语前半部分的英语词，指儿童。

entries.definition: A place caring for very young children, often from infancy.
entries.definitionCN: 英式常用，照看更小的孩子，有的从婴儿期开始。

entries.definition: A pre-primary group or class, and the adjective for the age.
entries.definitionCN: 指学前班，也作形容词表示入小学前的。

entries.definition: An informal gathering where small children play together.
entries.definitionCN: 英式说法，指幼儿一起玩的非正式小组。

normalIntro.en: These hooks take the word apart into children and a garden, and follow it to the classroom.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把词拆成「儿童」和「花园」，再把它领到教室里。

normal.en: Kinder is German for children, as in the word for children's clothes.
normal.cn: Kinder 是德语「儿童」，德语里童装也用这个词。

normal.en: Garten is German for garden.
normal.cn: Garten 是德语「花园」。

normal.en: The English plural is kindergartens, with -s.
normal.cn: 英语复数是 kindergartens，加 -s。

normal.en: Froebel founded it as a garden where children grow.
normal.cn: 福禄贝尔把它办成让孩子生长的花园。

normal.en: In the United States it is often the first year of school.
normal.cn: 在美国它常指正式上学的第一年。

abstract.en: A garden for children means nobody is expected to sit still all day.
abstract.cn: 儿童的花园意味着没人被要求整天坐直。

abstract.en: The word is a small monument to one man's idea about how children learn.
abstract.cn: 这个词是某人对「孩子怎样学」这一想法留下的一块小小纪念碑。

abstract.en: A borrowed word can carry a whole teaching method inside it.
abstract.cn: 一个借来的词可以把整套教学方法一起搬进来。

examples.en: The kindergarten closes early on Fridays.
examples.cn: 幼儿园周五提前关门。

examples.en: He cried on his first day at kindergarten.
examples.cn: 他第一天上幼儿园就哭了。

examples.en: Two kindergartens stand on the same street.
examples.cn: 同一条街上有两家幼儿园。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「坑的噶藤」——小孩在花园的藤架下挖坑玩，就是幼儿园

root: 德语复合词，Kinder（儿童）加 Garten（花园），由教育家福禄贝尔创办幼儿学校时创用，十九世纪进入英语，形成沿用至今的学前教育称谓。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: the school itself, the pre-school year, and the play-first method behind it.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：幼儿园这个机构、上学前的那一年，以及它背后以游戏为先的方法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: small children growing in a fenced garden of paper flowers.
core.cn: 核心意象：小孩子在纸花满墙的园子里生长。

branches.en: THE GARDEN LINE: a place and a method of growth.
branches.cn: 花园这条线：一处地方，也是一种生长方法。

branches.en: THE CALENDAR LINE: the place turns into a year.
branches.cn: 日历这条线：场所变成一个年份。

branches.en: THE GATE LINE: the morning handover at the fence.
branches.cn: 门口这条线：早晨在栅栏边的交接。

branches.en: THE FIRST STEP LINE: the earliest step outside the family.
branches.cn: 第一步这条线：走出家门的第一步。

branches.en: THE PLAY LINE: learning hidden inside play.
branches.cn: 游戏这条线：学习藏在游戏里。

intro.en: Because the word was borrowed whole, English adds only an English plural and a personal noun; the inner parts belong to German.
intro.cn: 因为整词借入，英语只加了英语复数和个人名词，内部成分仍属德语。

latinIntro.en: The parts are German, so the entries below record the German sources rather than Latin ones.
latinIntro.cn: 词内成分是德语，下面的条目记录德语来源而非拉丁语。

items.exampleCN: 三所幼儿园共用一个院子。

items.meaning: one group in such a school
items.example: The kindergarten class has twenty children.
items.exampleCN: 这个幼儿班有二十个孩子。
那个幼儿园小孩挥手告别。
德语里 Kinder 常出现在复合词中。

items.example: The kindergarten teacher sang with them.
items.exampleCN: 幼教老师带他们一起唱歌。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 拉丁语「花园」，与德语 Garten 只是意义相应

definition_zh: 善意；仁慈；亲切的行为
definition_en: the quality of being warm and helpful, and an act that shows it
core_image: 雨里有人把伞悄悄偏过去半个伞面
scene: 车棚下只有一把伞，撑伞的人往旁边挪了挪。Her small kindness, sharing one umbrella in the rain, made the whole walk bearable.
sceneCN: 这里 kindness 是「善意的举动」（第 2 个义项：体现善意的行为），句意是她雨中同撑一把伞的小小善意让整段路都变得好过了。画面里有车棚、一把伞和被雨打湿的肩头。

derivatives.zh: kindness 由 kind 加 -ness 构成，词基指和善的
由 kind 加 -ly 构成，指和善地，与名词 kindness 分工
un- 加 kindness 构成，指不厚道、刻薄
由 kindly 加 -ness 构成，与 kindness 近义但更书面

senses.title: The quality of being warm-hearted
senses.definition: the quality of caring about others and wanting to help them
senses.definitionCN: 关心他人并愿意相助的品质
senses.example: Kindness runs in that family.
senses.exampleCN: 那家人代代都心善。
senses.why: The suffix -ness turns the adjective for a warm nature into the name of that nature itself.
senses.whyCN: -ness 把表示温和天性的形容词变成了这种天性本身的名字。

senses.title: A concrete act that shows it
senses.definition: a specific helpful act, counted one by one
senses.definitionCN: 一次一次可数的具体帮助行为
senses.example: She did him a kindness and asked for nothing.
senses.exampleCN: 她帮了他一个忙，什么也没要。
senses.why: English lets one suffix name both a quality and its instances, so the noun counts acts as well as moods.
senses.whyCN: 英语允许同一个后缀既指性质又指具体事例，所以这个名词既能量举动也能量心态。

senses.title: Gentle treatment of the vulnerable
senses.definition: the care given to animals, children, or the sick because they cannot repay it
senses.definitionCN: 因为对方无力回报而对动物、孩子或病人给予的照顾
senses.example: He treats old horses with great kindness.
senses.exampleCN: 他对老马十分体贴。
senses.why: Kindness is most visible where it cannot be repaid, so the word is drawn to the weak and the dependent.
senses.whyCN: 善意在无法回报的地方最显眼，所以这个词被引向弱小和依赖者。

senses.title: A softening habit in speech
senses.definition: the habit of saying things so that no one is humiliated
senses.definitionCN: 习惯把话说得不让任何人难堪
senses.example: There was kindness even in his refusal.
senses.exampleCN: 就连他拒绝时也带着体贴。
senses.why: Because kindness is judged by its effect on listeners, a way of phrasing counts as the quality itself.
senses.whyCN: 因为善意要看听者的感受，所以一种措辞方式本身也算作这种品质。

senses.title: Both the giving and the receiving
senses.definition: the relationship opened up when one person helps and another accepts help
senses.definitionCN: 一人给予、另一人接受时所形成的关系
senses.example: Kindness given freely usually comes back.
senses.exampleCN: 白给的善意往往会回来。
senses.why: The word names a bond rather than a single person, because the act needs two sides to exist.
senses.whyCN: 这个词命名的是一种关系而非一个人，因为这种行为需要两边才能成立。

intro.en: Kindness is a native English formation: the old word for inborn nature, given the suffix that names a quality.
intro.cn: kindness 是英语本土构成：把表示天生天性的旧词，配上表示性质的后缀。

items.en: The base gecynd meant nature or inborn quality, the same root that gives kin.
items.cn: 词基 gecynd 指天性、天生的品质，与 kin 同根。

items.en: The shortened form kind developed the sense of gentle and well-disposed.
items.cn: 缩简形式 kind 发展出「温和、心地好」的义项。

items.en: The suffix -nes, later -ness, named a quality, so kindnes meant a gentle disposition.
items.cn: 后缀 -nes 后作 -ness，表示性质，于是 kindnes 指温和的性情。

items.en: The countable sense of an act of kindness appears as the word spreads into everyday courtesy talk.
items.cn: 随这个词进入日常礼貌用语，出现了可数的「一件善举」义。

items.en: Kindness of strangers became a fixed phrase in English writing on city life.
items.cn: 「陌生人的善意」在书写城市生活的英语里成为固定说法。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the -ness and -ly family built on kind; the near-meaning group holds other words for goodwill.
note.cn: 形近组收由 kind 加 -ness、-ly 的词族；近义组收其他表示好意的词。

entries.definition: The adjective and noun behind this quality word.
entries.definitionCN: 这个品质词所依赖的形容词与名词。

entries.definition: The adverb, warm in manner.
entries.definitionCN: 同族的副词，指和善地。

entries.definition: A near twin, built from kindly plus -ness.
entries.definitionCN: 由 kindly 加 -ness 构成的近义双胞胎词。

entries.definition: Family, the oldest sense of the root.
entries.definitionCN: 亲族，是这个词根最古老的含义。

entries.definition: Moral good quality, wider and more general.
entries.definitionCN: 指道德上的善，范围更宽更泛。

entries.definition: A free and giving spirit, often with money.
entries.definitionCN: 指大方慷慨，常与钱财有关。

entries.definition: Deep sympathy for someone who suffers.
entries.definitionCN: 指对受苦者的深切同情。

entries.definition: The deliberate causing of pain, the reverse of kindness.
entries.definitionCN: 指故意施加痛苦，是 kindness 的反面。

normalIntro.en: These hooks tie the -ness suffix to a root about inborn nature, and to the small acts people notice.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把 -ness 后缀系在表示天性的词根上，也系在人们看得见的小举动上。

normal.en: Kind plus -ness names a quality, not a person.
normal.cn: kind 加 -ness 命名的是性质，不是人。

normal.en: Kindly and kindness split adverb from noun.
normal.cn: kindly 与 kindness 一个是副词一个是名词。

normal.en: Unkindness adds un- for the harsh opposite.
normal.cn: unkindness 加 un- 表示刻薄的反面。

normal.en: An act of kindness counts one helpful deed.
normal.cn: an act of kindness 数的是具体的一件好事。

normal.en: Out of kindness explains the motive, not the action.
normal.cn: out of kindness 说明的是动机而非行动。

abstract.en: Kindness is an umbrella tipped a little toward the other shoulder.
abstract.cn: 善意就是把伞稍稍偏向别人的肩。

abstract.en: A quality word with a countable sense means it can be counted in deeds.
abstract.cn: 一个能计数的性质词，意味着它可以按举动来数。

abstract.en: Kin and kindness come from one root: warmth begins with those nearest.
abstract.cn: kin 与 kindness 同源：温暖从最近的人开始。

examples.en: He never forgot her kindness in that hard year.
examples.cn: 那艰难的一年里她的善意他从未忘记。

examples.en: Small kindnesses make a long journey lighter.
examples.cn: 小小的善举让漫长的旅程轻快些。

examples.en: She thanked the nurse for her kindness.
examples.cn: 她感谢护士的照顾和善意。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「肯得奈斯」——肯得下心把好先给人，就是善意

root: 古英语 gecynd（天性）派生 kind，加名词后缀 -ness（古英语 -nes）构成 kindness，由「天生温和的性情」扩展出「善举」的可数用法；与 kin 同根。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses: the quality itself, a countable helpful act, care for the weak, a softening way of speech, and the bond between giver and receiver.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项：品质本身、可数的善举、对弱者的照顾、说话留余地的习惯，以及施与受之间的关系。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: warmth offered from one person's hand to another's.
core.cn: 核心意象：暖意从一个人的手递到另一个人的手上。

branches.en: THE QUALITY LINE: a mood and its countable deeds.
branches.cn: 品质这条线：一种心态和可数的举动。

branches.en: THE WEAK LINE: care where nothing can be repaid.
branches.cn: 弱者这条线：得不到回报处的照顾。

branches.en: THE VOICE LINE: kindness heard in phrasing.
branches.cn: 声音这条线：从措辞里听到的体贴。

branches.en: THE BOND LINE: an act that needs two sides.
branches.cn: 关系这条线：必须有两边才成立的行为。

branches.en: THE LIFE LINE: from inborn nature to a returned favour.
branches.cn: 生活这条线：从天生性情到回报的好意。

intro.en: The word is one root plus one suffix, so the items show the root, the suffix, the negated form, and the near doublet.
intro.cn: 这个词是一个词根加一个后缀，下面列出词根、后缀、否定形式与近义的双胞胎词。

latinIntro.en: Both root and suffix are Germanic, so no true Latin family exists; the entries below are contrasts only.
latinIntro.cn: 词根与后缀都属日耳曼语，因此没有真正的拉丁词族，下面的条目只是对照。

items.exampleCN: 他的善举一件件累积起来。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 拉丁语「善意、宽厚」，与 kindness 只是意义相应
拉丁语「仁厚、教养」，仅作意义上的对照

definition_zh: 王国；国度；（生物分类的）界；领域
definition_en: a country ruled by a king or queen, and by extension a whole domain such as living things or a field of activity
core_image: 地图上一大片被围起来的疆土，界线外写着别人的名字
scene: 旧地图摊在桌上，纸边已经卷起。That kingdom once reached from the mountains to the sea.
sceneCN: 这里 kingdom 是「王国」（第 1 个义项：由国王或女王统治的国家），句意是那个王国当时从山区一直延伸到海边。画面里有摊开的旧地图、卷起的纸边和海岸线。

pos.zh: 领域；王国（喻某事物自成一体）

derivatives.zh: kingdom 的词基，指国王
与 kingdom 同后缀 -dom 的词，指自由，说明该后缀表示状态
duke 加 -dom 构成，指公爵领地，同一模式的其他爵位
kingdom 加 wide 合成，指全国范围的

senses.title: A country ruled by a monarch
senses.definition: a state whose head is a king or a queen
senses.definitionCN: 以国王或女王为国家元首的国家
senses.example: The kingdom lasted more than six hundred years.
senses.exampleCN: 这个王国延续了六百多年。
senses.why: The suffix -dom names a realm or a condition, so king plus -dom names the place a king holds.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -dom 表示领域或状态，因此 king 加 -dom 就是国王所辖的地方。

senses.title: A monarchy as a political form
senses.definition: a country with a monarch as its constitutional form of government
senses.definitionCN: 以君主为政体的国家形式
senses.example: Three kingdoms share that island.
senses.exampleCN: 那座岛上共有三个君主国。
senses.why: When the word names a political form rather than a person's land, it enters the language of constitutions.
senses.whyCN: 当这个词指政体而非某人的土地时，它就进入了宪法的语汇。

senses.title: One of the great divisions of living things
senses.definition: the highest rank in the traditional classification of living things
senses.definitionCN: 传统生物分类中的最高等级
senses.example: Fungi form their own kingdom.
senses.exampleCN: 真菌自成一大界。
senses.why: Classification needed a word for the top level, and the royal realm supplied a natural image of rank.
senses.whyCN: 分类学需要为最高层级找一个词，而王国的疆域恰好提供了等级的自然意象。

senses.title: A separate world of its own
senses.definition: an area of activity or interest that feels like a closed world
senses.definitionCN: 感觉像一个封闭世界的活动或兴趣范围
senses.example: The old bookshop is a kingdom of paper and dust.
senses.exampleCN: 那家旧书店是纸与灰自成一体的小天地。
senses.why: A kingdom has its own law and borders, so any self-contained world can be called one.
senses.whyCN: 王国自成法律与边界，因此任何自成一体的世界都能这样称呼。

senses.title: The realm of God or the dead
senses.definition: a religious name for the realm of God or of the dead
senses.definitionCN: 宗教用语，指上帝所辖或亡者所在的世界
senses.example: The prayer asks for the kingdom to come.
senses.exampleCN: 那篇祈祷文祈求天国降临。
senses.why: Religion borrowed the political word to speak of a rule that is not of this world.
senses.whyCN: 宗教借用了政治词来描述一种不属于此世的统治。

intro.en: Kingdom is a native compound: the old word for a clan head joined to a Germanic suffix that names a state or a realm.
intro.cn: kingdom 是本土复合词：表示氏族首领的旧词接上表示状态或领域的日耳曼后缀。

items.en: The suffix appears in Germanic as -domaz, naming a condition, a rank, or a jurisdiction.
items.cn: 这个后缀在日耳曼语中作 -domaz，表示状态、身份或管辖范围。

items.en: Old English had cyningdom, the domain of a cyning, and the suffix was -dom.
items.cn: 古英语已有 cyningdom，指 cyning（王）的辖地，后缀作 -dom。

items.en: Religious texts used the word for the rule of God, giving the kingdom of heaven.
items.cn: 宗教文本用这个词指上帝的统治，产生了「天国」的说法。

items.en: The form settled as kingdom and the plural took -s.
items.cn: 词形固定为 kingdom，复数加 -s。

items.en: Biology adopted the word for its highest rank of living things in the eighteenth century.
items.cn: 十八世纪生物学采用这个词指生物的最高分类级。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the -dom family and the king root; the near-meaning group holds other words for a state or a realm.
note.cn: 形近组收 -dom 词族与 king 词根；近义组收其他表示国家或领域的词。

entries.definition: The ruler whose realm this word names.
entries.definitionCN: 指国王，也就是这个词所指疆域的统治者。

entries.definition: A duke's territory, the same pattern one rank lower.
entries.definitionCN: 指公爵领，是同一模式下的低一级。

entries.definition: The same -dom naming a state rather than a place.
entries.definitionCN: 同样带 -dom，但表示状态而非地方。

entries.definition: An earl's rank and land, another rank in the same series.
entries.definitionCN: 指伯爵的身份与封地，同一序列的另一级。

entries.definition: A group of states under one supreme ruler.
entries.definitionCN: 指由一位至高统治者统辖的多个国家。

entries.definition: A people and their country, whether monarchical or not.
entries.definitionCN: 指一个民族及其国家，不论是否有君主。

entries.definition: A kingdom, and also any field of activity.
entries.definitionCN: 指王国，也可指任何活动领域。

entries.definition: A state with an elected head, the reverse of a monarchy.
entries.definitionCN: 指元首经选举产生的国家，与君主国相对。

normalIntro.en: These hooks join the king root to the suffix for a realm, then follow the word into biology and religion.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把 king 词根接上表示领域的后缀，再把它带进生物学与宗教。

normal.en: -Dom names a state or a realm, as in freedom and dukedom.
normal.cn: -dom 表示状态或领域，如 freedom 与 dukedom。

normal.en: United Kingdom is the fixed name for Britain in official use.
normal.cn: United Kingdom 是英国在正式场合的固定名称。

normal.en: Animal kingdom is the top division of animals in old classification.
normal.cn: animal kingdom 是旧分类中动物的最高一级。

normal.en: Kingdom and king differ only by the suffix.
normal.cn: kingdom 与 king 只差一个后缀。

normal.en: The plural is kingdoms, never kingdomes.
normal.cn: 复数是 kingdoms，不写 kingdomes。

abstract.en: A kingdom is a line drawn around people who accept one name.
abstract.cn: 王国就是画在一群认可同一个名字的人外面的那条线。

abstract.en: Every field that feels complete becomes a kingdom of its own.
abstract.cn: 任何自成一体的领域都会变成它自己的王国。

abstract.en: Biology borrowed a throne to sort living things into great halls.
abstract.cn: 生物学借来一张王座，把生物分进几个大堂。

examples.en: The kingdom was divided among three brothers.
examples.cn: 这个王国被三个兄弟分了。

examples.en: Insects make up most of the animal kingdom.
examples.cn: 昆虫占了动物界的大部分。

examples.en: That garden is her own small kingdom.
examples.cn: 那座花园是她自己的小王国。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「king 的母」——国王的地盘就叫王国

root: 古英语 cyningdom，由 cyning（王，源出日耳曼语「族人头领」）加后缀 -dom（表示状态、领域）构成；后由具体疆土扩为政体名、生物分类的最高一级及喻义的「领域」。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses: a monarch's country, monarchy as a political form, the top rank in biology, a self-contained world, and the religious realm.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项：君主所治的国家、作为政体的君主国、生物分类的最高一级、自成一体的小天地，以及宗教上的国度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a border drawn around the land one name rules.
core.cn: 核心意象：围绕一个名字所辖之地画下的一条界线。

branches.en: THE MAP LINE: a country and the constitutional form it takes.
branches.cn: 地图这条线：一个国家以及它的政体形式。

branches.en: THE CLASSIFICATION LINE: rank borrowed for living things.
branches.cn: 分类这条线：借用等级来给生物排序。

branches.en: THE INNER LINE: a world small enough to hold in one room.
branches.cn: 内心这条线：小到能装进一间屋子的世界。

branches.en: THE PRAYER LINE: a rule not of this world.
branches.cn: 祈祷这条线：不属于此世的统治。

branches.en: THE BORDER LINE: every kingdom is defined by what lies outside.
branches.cn: 边界这条线：每个王国都由界外之物来界定。

intro.en: The word is a root plus a Germanic suffix, and the suffix is the lesson: it builds freedom, dukedom, and earldom the same way.
intro.cn: 这个词是词根加日耳曼后缀，真正值得学的是后缀：它同样造出 freedom、dukedom、earldom。

latinIntro.en: Neither part is Latin, so the entries below are only Latin words for a kingdom or a rule, given for contrast.
latinIntro.cn: 两个部分都不来自拉丁语，下面列出的只是表示王国或统治的拉丁词，作对照用。

items.exampleCN: 这个王国只有一条大路。
他的君王气度令人印象深刻。

items.example: The dukedom passed to a cousin.
items.exampleCN: 公爵领地传给了一位堂亲。
一道全国性的敕令被宣读。

items.example: The United Kingdom has four parts.
items.exampleCN: 联合王国由四部分组成。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 拉丁语「统治权、帝国」，与 kingdom 意义相近而制度不同

definition_zh: 成套工具；工具箱；配套元件；装备
definition_en: a set of parts or tools kept together for a particular purpose, or the equipment a person carries for an activity
core_image: 一只敞开的帆布箱，工具、零件与说明按格摆齐
scene: 车停在山路边熄了火，后备箱里那只帆布包派上了用场。He opened the repair kit and found a spare belt and a small torch in it.
sceneCN: 这里 kit 是「成套工具、工具箱」（第 1 个义项：为某用途配套收纳的一套工具或零件），句意是他打开修理包，在里面找到一条备用皮带和一只小手电。画面里有山路、熄火的车和敞开的帆布包。

pos.zh: 名词：成套工具；配套元件；装备
动词：装备（用 kit out、kit up 搭配）

derivatives.zh: kit 的复数形式，义为「多套工具或装备」
由动词加 -ed 构成，英式口语义为「装备齐全的」
kit 与 bag 合成，义为「行囊、工具袋」
外形相近但词源不同，义为「厨房」

senses.title: A set of tools kept together
senses.definition: a set of tools, parts, or equipment packed together for a specific job
senses.definitionCN: 为特定用途配套收纳的工具、零件或装备
senses.example: Every car should carry a basic tool kit.
senses.exampleCN: 每辆车都该带一套基本工具。
senses.why: The word started as a wooden tub for holding a soldier things, and the container came to stand for the set it held.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指装士兵杂物的木盆，容器后来代表它所装的那一整套。

senses.title: Equipment for an activity
senses.definition: the clothes and equipment that a person needs for a sport, a job, or a journey
senses.definitionCN: 个人从事运动、工作或旅行所需的衣物与器具
senses.example: His football kit was drying on the radiator.
senses.exampleCN: 他的足球装备正在暖气片上晾着。
senses.why: Once it named a soldier belongings, the word naturally widened to anyone gear for a task.
senses.whyCN: 它既曾指士兵的随身之物，扩而广之指任何人做某件事的行头。

senses.title: Parts sold ready to assemble
senses.definition: a set of parts sold together to be put together by the buyer, as for a model or furniture
senses.definitionCN: 一起出售、由购买者自行组装的零件，如模型或家具
senses.example: The shelf came as a kit with screws and a diagram.
senses.exampleCN: 这个架子以套件形式出售，附螺丝和图解。
senses.why: In trade the container word turned into a commercial unit: everything you need, sold in one box.
senses.whyCN: 在买卖里，容器词变成了一个出售单位：所需之物全装在一只箱子里卖出。

senses.title: To equip someone
senses.definition: in the phrases kit out and kit up, to provide someone with clothes or equipment
senses.definitionCN: 用于 kit out、kit up，指为某人提供衣物或装备
senses.example: The team was kitted out in new shirts.
senses.exampleCN: 队伍换上了整套新球衣。
senses.why: From the noun of supplies came the verb of handing them out, a frequent path in English.
senses.whyCN: 由补给品之名的名词生出「发放补给」的动词，这是英语里常见的一条路。

intro.en: Kit appears in late Middle English as the name of a wooden tub, and the history before that is debated.
intro.cn: kit 在中古英语晚期以「木盆」之义出现，再往前的来历尚有争议。

items.en: Kyt or kit named a wooden tub or tankard used for holding liquids or provisions.
items.cn: kyt 或 kit 指盛液体或食物的木盆、木桶。

items.en: The closest early relative is the Middle Dutch kitte, a wooden tub made of staves, which supports a Dutch source.
items.cn: 最早的近亲是中古荷兰语 kitte，一种板条拼成的木盆，这支持荷兰语来源说。

items.en: A link with German Kütze or with Old French cuve has also been proposed, and scholars do not fully agree.
items.cn: 也有人提出与德语 Kütze 或古法语 cuve 有关，学界尚未取得一致。

items.en: Soldiers carried a kit, and from the tub the name shifted to the whole set of personal gear.
items.cn: 士兵随身带着 kit，名字由木盆转到了整套个人装备上。

items.en: In the twentieth century kit became the standard word for a boxed set of parts, from models to medical supplies.
items.cn: 二十世纪里 kit 成为「盒装成套零件」的标准说法，从模型到医疗用品都用它。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers short words that differ from kit by one sound or letter; the near-meaning group gathers other words for a prepared set.
note.cn: 形近组收与 kit 只差一个音或一个字母的短词；近义组收其他表示「备好的一套」的说法。

entries.definition: One letter apart; it names the flying toy and a bird of prey.
entries.definitionCN: 只差一个字母，指风筝以及一种猛禽。

entries.definition: Adds a syllable to kit and names a young cat.
entries.definitionCN: 在 kit 后多加一个音节，指小猫。

entries.definition: Differs by one letter and means a young goat or, informally, a child.
entries.definitionCN: 只差一个字母，指小山羊，口语中也指孩子。

entries.definition: A group of things used together, wider and more neutral than kit.
entries.definitionCN: 一起使用的一组物品，范围更宽、语体更中性。

entries.definition: A container of goods sold or carried together.
entries.definitionCN: 一起出售或携带的一包物品。

entries.definition: Equipment for an activity, usually uncountable.
entries.definitionCN: 某项活动所用的装备，通常不可数。

normalIntro.en: The hooks connect the wooden tub, the soldier bag and the modern boxed set that the word has named in turn.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把木盆、士兵行囊与现代盒装套件依次连起来，这几个东西都曾被这个词指称。

normal.en: Kit doubles the t before -ed and -ing: kitted, kitting.
normal.cn: kit 在加 -ed、-ing 前要双写 t：kitted、kitting。

normal.en: The word once meant a wooden tub; the container still leads to the contents.
normal.cn: 这个词曾指木盆；容器仍然指向它所装的东西。

normal.en: First-aid kit and tool kit are the two phrases you will meet most.
normal.cn: first-aid kit 与 tool kit 是最常遇到的两个搭配。

normal.en: Kit out is the verb form: to fit someone out with gear.
normal.cn: kit out 是动词用法：给某人配齐装备。

normal.en: Do not confuse it with kitchen, which is only a look-alike, not a relative.
normal.cn: 别与厨房 kitchen 混淆，后者只是形近，并非同源。

abstract.en: A kit is a promise of readiness: everything has its place before the need arrives.
abstract.cn: 一套 kit 就是一份「已准备好」的承诺：在需要到来之前，一切各就各位。

abstract.en: The word moves from the box to what is in it, the way a toolbox can stand for the tools.
abstract.cn: 这个词从箱子走到箱中之物，正如工具箱可以代表工具本身。

abstract.en: Parts in a kit are potential: they become a shelf or a model only when someone puts them together.
abstract.cn: 套件里的零件只是潜能：有人把它们拼起来，才成为架子或模型。

examples.en: Take a first-aid kit on the hike.
examples.cn: 徒步时带上一只急救箱。

examples.en: The model plane came as a kit for beginners.
examples.cn: 这架模型飞机以适合初学者的套件形式出售。

examples.en: The club kitted out the new players in matching shirts.
examples.cn: 俱乐部给新队员配齐了统一球衣。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「齐特」——齐全的特殊物件，装成一箱就是成套工具

root: 中古英语 kyt / kit 指木盆、木桶，可能来自中古荷兰语 kitte（板条木盆），也有德语或古法语来源的猜测，尚无定论；后指士兵的随身行囊，再引申为「一整套工具、装备、套件」。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: the set of tools in a container, a person own equipment, a boxed set of parts to assemble, and the verb of equipping.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：装在容器里的一套工具，个人装备，盒装配件，以及「给某人配装备」的动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open canvas box with every tool and part in its own slot.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只敞开的帆布箱，工具与零件各在各自的格子里。

branches.en: THE TOOLS: the set is kept together so that a job can be done at once.
branches.cn: 工具线：整套放在一起，随时可以动手。

branches.en: THE PERSON: gear for a sport or journey belongs to one body.
branches.cn: 个人线：运动或旅行的装备归属于一个人。

branches.en: THE BOX SALE: parts sold together, to be built at home.
branches.cn: 盒装线：零件一起出售，由买者在家里装好。

branches.en: THE VERB LINE: the noun of supplies gives a verb of handing them out.
branches.cn: 动词线：补给品之名生出「发放补给」的动词。

branches.en: THE OLD TUB: the container image still explains why a kit holds a set.
branches.cn: 旧木盆线：容器的意象仍能解释为什么 kit 装着一整套。

intro.en: Kit is a short native noun that grows by inflection and by compounds rather than by Latin affixes.
intro.cn: kit 是短小的本土名词，靠词形变化与合成扩展，而非拉丁语词缀。

latinIntro.en: Kit has no Latin source; the tub words below are given only as historical neighbours.
latinIntro.cn: kit 没有拉丁语来源，下面这些「桶、盆」词只作为历史上的近邻列出。

items.meaning: a set of tools or gear

items.example: Both kits are on the shelf.
items.exampleCN: 两个工具箱都在架子上。

items.example: The team is kitted and ready.
items.exampleCN: 队伍装备齐整，准备就绪。

items.example: Kitting out a new lab takes weeks.
items.exampleCN: 给新实验室配齐装备要花好几周。

items.meaningCN: 与 kit 构成 kit out
items.exampleCN: 它补足 kit out 这一搭配。

items.meaningCN: 与 kit 构成 kit up
items.exampleCN: 它补足 kit up 这一搭配。

items.example: He threw his kitbag on the bus.
items.exampleCN: 他把行李袋扔上了巴士。
它把 kit 变成 kits。

latinEntries.structure: Medieval Latin noun from Latin cupa

definition_zh: 跪下；跪着；屈膝
definition_en: to go down or rest on one or both knees, as in prayer, respect, or obedience
core_image: 礼拜堂里一个人双膝落地，脊背挺直，头微微低下
scene: 老教堂的长椅之间，木地板被磨得发亮。She knelt beside the pew and prayed quietly for a long minute.
sceneCN: 这里 kneel 是「跪下、跪着」（第 1 个义项：用膝盖着地），句意是她在长椅旁跪下，安静地祷告了很长一分钟。画面里有老教堂、长椅与磨亮的木地板。

pos.zh: 动词：跪下；跪着；屈膝（表示敬意或服从）

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「跪姿、跪着」
加 -er 构成，义为「跪垫、下跪的人」
与 kneel 同源的名词，义为「膝盖」

senses.title: To go down on the knees
senses.definition: to go down onto the knees or rest with the weight on them
senses.definitionCN: 用膝盖着地，或把身体重量压在膝上
senses.example: He knelt down to tie the child shoe.
senses.exampleCN: 他跪下给孩子系鞋带。
senses.why: The verb describes the movement of the body onto its knee, a posture reached from standing.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词描述身体下沉到膝盖上的动作，是一种从站立到达的姿势。

senses.title: To show respect or submission
senses.definition: to kneel as a sign of reverence toward a person, a god, or a power
senses.definitionCN: 为向人、神或权力表示敬意而下跪
senses.example: The knights knelt before the queen.
senses.exampleCN: 骑士们在女王面前跪下。
senses.why: Because lowering the body means lowering oneself, the plain posture became the gesture of respect and surrender.
senses.whyCN: 因为压低身体就意味着压低自己，这一姿势便成为敬意与臣服的姿态。

senses.title: To pray while kneeling
senses.definition: to pray with the body on the knees, as many traditions do
senses.definitionCN: 像许多传统那样，双膝落地地祈祷
senses.example: The whole family knelt together every evening.
senses.exampleCN: 全家人每晚一起跪下祷告。
senses.why: Prayer made the posture a routine, so the verb often implies what is being done in that position.
senses.whyCN: 祷告让这种姿势成了常规，所以这个动词常暗含在这个姿势里所做的事。

intro.en: Kneel is the verb matching the noun knee, and both come from one Old English root.
intro.cn: kneel 是与名词 knee 相配的动词，二者出自同一个古英语词根。

items.en: The verb cneowlian described going down on the knees, beside the noun cneo.
items.cn: 动词 cneowlian 描述跪下的动作，与名词 cneo 并列。

items.en: Northern texts also show cneolian, and both forms share the silent k of the noun family.
items.cn: 北部文本又见 cneolian，两种形式都带着词族中不发音的 k。

items.en: The form settles as knelen, and the past tense knelede later shrinks to knelt.
items.cn: 词形定为 knelen，过去式 knelede 后来缩为 knelt。

items.en: English keeps knelt as the usual past tense, with kneeled as a common American variant.
items.cn: 英语以 knelt 为常用过去式，kneeled 则是常见的美式变体。

items.en: The verb is now used for prayer, respect, obedience, and the practical act of getting low to work.
items.cn: 如今这个动词用于祈祷、致敬、服从，以及低身干活这样的实用动作。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words with the same silent k and the same vowel; the near-meaning group gathers postures and related actions.
note.cn: 形近组收同样带不发音的 k 与同样元音的词；近义组收其他姿势与相关动作。

entries.definition: The noun from the same Old English root, naming the joint that bends.
entries.definitionCN: 同出古英语词根的名词，指那处会弯的关节。

entries.definition: Sounds almost the same but means to press and fold dough.
entries.definitionCN: 读音几乎相同，但意思是按压折叠面团。

entries.definition: Written without the n, and names the spine of a ship.
entries.definitionCN: 少了 n，指船的龙骨。

entries.definition: To bend low with the knees, keeping the feet flat.
entries.definitionCN: 屈膝低身，脚掌着地。

entries.definition: To sit with the knees bent and the weight on the feet, without the knees touching the ground.
entries.definitionCN: 屈膝坐着，重量落在脚上，膝盖不触地。

entries.definition: To bend the upper body as a greeting or sign of respect.
entries.definitionCN: 弯下上半身表示问候或敬意。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Old English pair, the two past forms, and the scenes where kneeling happens.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子使用真实的古英语一对词、两种过去式，以及下跪实际发生的场景。

normal.en: Kneel and knee come from the same Old English root; the verb is the noun in motion.
normal.cn: kneel 与 knee 同出古英语词根；动词就是运动中的名词。

normal.en: The k is silent, just as in knee, knife and knock.
normal.cn: k 不发音，和 knee、knife、knock 一样。

normal.en: British English prefers knelt; American English also uses kneeled.
normal.cn: 英式英语偏好 knelt，美式英语也用 kneeled。

normal.en: Kneel down adds nothing in meaning but adds the direction of the movement.
normal.cn: kneel down 没有增加意义，只补出动作的方向。

normal.en: Kneeling in prayer is the most common use of the word.
normal.cn: 祈祷时下跪是这个词最常见的用法。

abstract.en: Going down on the knees is the shortest way to make oneself smaller than the person in front.
abstract.cn: 双膝落地是把自己在对方面前压低的最短路径。

abstract.en: The posture is a sentence without words: the body says what the mouth might not.
abstract.cn: 这个姿势是一句不用词的话：身体说出嘴未必说出的意思。

abstract.en: The same verb covers prayer and tying a shoelace, since the body does not know the difference.
abstract.cn: 同一个动词既指祈祷也指系鞋带，因为身体不做这种区分。

examples.en: She knelt to look the child in the eye.
examples.cn: 她蹲跪下来，与孩子平视。

examples.en: The crowd knelt as the procession passed.
examples.cn: 队伍经过时人群跪下。

examples.en: He was still kneeling in the garden when the rain began.
examples.cn: 雨下起来时他还在花园里跪着。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「尼尔」——膝盖一弯，人就矮了一截

root: 古英语动词 cneowlian / cneolian（跪下），与名词 cneo「膝」同源，共有一个后来不发音的 k；中古英语 knelen，过去式由 knelede 缩为 knelt，美式另作 kneeled。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: the physical act of going down on the knees, the same act as a sign of respect, and the prayer made in that posture.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：用膝着地的身体动作，同样动作所表示的敬意，以及在这个姿势里所做的祈祷。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a body lowering until its weight rests on the knees.
core.cn: 核心意象：身体下沉，直到重量落在双膝上。

branches.en: THE BODY: the plain movement from standing to resting on the knees.
branches.cn: 身体线：从站立到以膝支撑的直白动作。

branches.en: THE GESTURE: the low posture becomes a sign of honour or surrender.
branches.cn: 姿态线：低下的姿势成为致敬或臣服的标志。

branches.en: THE PRAYER: in many traditions prayer is made on the knees.
branches.cn: 祈祷线：许多传统中祈祷就是在膝上完成的。

branches.en: THE ROOT LINE: the verb and the noun knee share one Old English origin.
branches.cn: 词根线：这个动词与名词 knee 共有一个古英语来源。

branches.en: THE FORM LINE: knelt and kneeled are both accepted past forms.
branches.cn: 形式线：knelt 与 kneeled 都是可接受的过去式。

intro.en: Kneel is a native verb whose family is small: inflection, a few suffixes, and the noun knee beside it.
intro.cn: kneel 是本土动词，词族很小：词形变化、几个后缀，以及一旁的同源名词 knee。

latinIntro.en: Kneel has no Latin ancestry; the Latin words below refer to the same posture only as comparisons.
latinIntro.cn: kneel 没有拉丁语血统，下面这些拉丁词只是同一姿势的对照。

items.meaning: to go down on the knees

items.example: The man kneeling is a guide.
items.exampleCN: 跪着的那个男人是向导。

items.meaning: one who, or a thing for
items.example: It forms kneeler, a kneeling cushion.
The knee rests on the cushion.

items.exampleCN: 它把 kneel 变成 kneels。

latinEntries.structure: Latin verb from genu and flectere

definition_zh: 实验室；实验课
definition_en: a room or building with special equipment where scientific work and tests are carried out
core_image: 一排白瓷台面，玻璃器皿与滴管安静地立着
scene: 深夜的走廊只亮着一盏应急灯。The lab on the third floor was still busy, with two students checking samples under the lamp.
sceneCN: 这里 lab 是「实验室」（第 1 个义项：配备专门设备做科学实验的房间），句意是三楼实验室仍然忙碌，两个学生在灯下检查样本。画面里有深夜走廊、应急灯与白瓷台面。

pos.zh: 名词：实验室；实验课；实验工作

derivatives.zh: lab 的完整形式，义为「实验室」
lab 与 based 合成，义为「以实验室为基础的」
lab 与 coat 合成，义为「实验服」

senses.title: A room for scientific work
senses.definition: a room or building fitted with instruments where experiments and tests are done
senses.definitionCN: 配有仪器、进行实验与检测的房间或建筑
senses.example: The samples were sent to the lab for analysis.
senses.exampleCN: 样本被送到实验室分析。
senses.why: The word is a cut-down form of laboratory, and short words suit the busy informal speech of the bench.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是 laboratory 的截短形式，而简短的词正合实验台旁的日常口语。

senses.title: A practical class
senses.definition: a period of teaching in which students do practical work, often in the phrase lab session
senses.definitionCN: 学生学习实际操作的教学时段，常作 lab session
senses.example: We have a physics lab on Thursday mornings.
senses.exampleCN: 我们周四上午有物理实验课。
senses.why: Students name the timetabled session after the room where it happens, a common shift in schools.
senses.whyCN: 学生用上课的房间来命名那节课，这在校园里是常见的转指。

senses.title: A place for testing ideas
senses.definition: a setting, often outside science, where new ideas are tried out
senses.definitionCN: 常不限于科学、用于试验新想法的场所或环境
senses.example: The city became a lab for new transport schemes.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市成了新交通方案的试验场。
senses.why: A lab is a place built for testing, so any situation used to try things out borrows its name.
senses.whyCN: 实验室是为检验而设的地方，因此任何用来试新事的情境都借用它的名字。

intro.en: Lab is a shortened form of laboratory, and it became a word in its own right only in the twentieth century.
intro.cn: lab 是 laboratory 的缩略形式，作为独立词通行是二十世纪的事。

items.en: The Latin verb laborare meant to work, and laboratorium named a place for work.
items.cn: 拉丁语动词 laborare 意为「工作」，laboratorium 指干活的地方。

items.en: In alchemy the laboratorium was the room where heating and distillation were done.
items.cn: 炼金术里 laboratorium 是做加热与蒸馏的房间。

items.en: English borrowed laboratory in the seventeenth century for rooms where scientific work was done.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪借入 laboratory，指做科学工作的房间。

items.en: The clipping lab appears in the late nineteenth century, and students and colleagues spread it.
items.cn: 缩略形式 lab 出现于十九世纪晚期，由学生与同行传开。

items.en: In the twentieth century lab also names the practical class and any place where ideas are tested.
items.cn: 二十世纪时 lab 也指实验课，以及任何试验新想法的场所。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers short words close in spelling; the near-meaning group gathers other places for scientific or practical work.
note.cn: 形近组收拼写接近的短词；近义组收其他科学或实践场所。

entries.definition: The full word from which lab is cut, and the more formal choice on signs.
entries.definitionCN: lab 所缩略的完整词，标牌上更正式的用字。

entries.definition: Shares the Latin work root, and means physical work or workers.
entries.definitionCN: 与之共享拉丁语「劳动」词根，指体力劳动或劳工。

entries.definition: Two letters apart, and names a rounded part of an organ.
entries.definitionCN: 差两个字母，指器官上圆钝的一部分。

entries.definition: A room with tools for making or repairing things.
entries.definitionCN: 放着工具、用来制作或修理的房间。

entries.definition: A room where an artist or a broadcaster works.
entries.definitionCN: 艺术家或播音人员工作的房间。

entries.definition: A place where patients are examined and treated.
entries.definitionCN: 检查与治疗病人的场所。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin work root, the clipping history and the collocations the word now has.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子使用真实的拉丁语「劳动」词根、缩略历史，以及如今的常见搭配。

normal.en: Lab is laboratory cut short, the way phone is telephone cut short.
normal.cn: lab 是 laboratory 的截短，正如 phone 是 telephone 的截短。

normal.en: Laboratory comes from Latin laborare, to work, so a lab is a workroom.
normal.cn: laboratory 出自拉丁语 laborare（工作），所以实验室就是干活的屋子。

normal.en: Lab work and lab report are the two phrases students meet first.
normal.cn: lab work 与 lab report 是学生最先遇到的两个搭配。

normal.en: A language lab teaches speech with recordings, not chemistry.
normal.cn: language lab 用录音教人说话，与化学无关。

normal.en: The plural is plain labs, with no extra change.
normal.cn: 复数是简单的 labs，没有别的变化。

abstract.en: A lab is a room built for questions: every instrument exists to take one doubt out of the world.
abstract.cn: 实验室是为问题而建的房间：每件仪器都是为消除一个疑虑而存在。

abstract.en: The word is short because work in such rooms is quick, repeated and spoken about every day.
abstract.cn: 这个词短，是因为这类房间里的工作迅速、重复、天天要提。

abstract.en: Once a lab meant a place for alchemy, now any city can be a lab for testing change.
abstract.cn: 曾经实验室是炼金之处，如今任何一座城市都可以成为试验变革的实验室。

examples.en: The water samples were tested in the lab.
examples.cn: 水样在实验室里做了检测。

examples.en: We have a chemistry lab every Tuesday.
examples.cn: 我们每周二有一次化学实验课。

examples.en: The old factory became a lab for new designs.
examples.cn: 那座旧工厂成了新设计的试验场。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「来百」——来上百次实验，才得一个结果

root: 拉丁语 laborare「工作」的派生名词 laboratorium（干活之所），炼金术时代指加热致馏的房间；十七世纪英语借入 laboratory，十九世纪晚期缩略为 lab，二十世纪扩展到实验课与试验场。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: the room with instruments, the practical class held there, and any place where ideas are tried out.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：放仪器的房间，在那里上的实验课，以及任何试验新想法的地方。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bench of white tiles with glassware, lamps and a notebook waiting.
core.cn: 核心意象：白瓷砖台面上摆着玻璃器皿、灯和一本待写的笔记。

branches.en: THE ROOM LINE: a space fitted out for experiment and test.
branches.cn: 房间线：为实验与检测而装配的空间。

branches.en: THE CLASS LINE: the timetabled session takes the name of the room.
branches.cn: 课程线：排定的课时借用了房间之名。

branches.en: THE METAPHOR LINE: any setting used to try new ideas becomes a lab.
branches.cn: 比喻线：任何试验新想法的情境都成了实验室。

branches.en: THE WORK LINE: the Latin root laborare makes a lab a place of work.
